parse.title: 2026 local electoral calendar
parse.text:
Worldwide local elections held in 2026
For national elections, see 2026 national electoral calendar.

2026 local electoral calendar
← 2025
2027 →

This local electoral calendar for 2026 lists the subnational elections held, and scheduled to be held, in 2026. Referendums, recall and retention elections, and national by-elections (special elections) are also included. Specific dates are given where these are known.
